info.headline: Mahanadi delta: flooding expected at a Naraj flow of 23,940 m3/s
info.description: MAHANADI DELTA - EXPECTED FLOODING FOR A NARAJ FLOW OF 23,940 m3/s (8.5 lakh cusec), lead time 24 h (flow = highest daily flow over 5 days at Naraj, the measure the atlas is fitted on; method: analog maps on river flow and 171 mm of 7-day rain; similar past passes: 20200828, 20200831, 20210919, 20220816, 20220818, 20260828, 20260831) Expected flooded land: 105 km2 People living on that land: 11,802 Settlements with at least 10 % of people on flooded land: 6 - near Patkura (9.7 km): about 193 people (28% of 704) at 20.3133 N, 86.3615 E - near Patkura (2.7 km): about 99 people (15% of 647) at 20.4002 N, 86.3823 E - near Patkura (9.3 km): about 77 people (29% of 269) at 20.3113 N, 86.3760 E - near Dhuria (8.6 km): about 60 people (11% of 529) at 20.4610 N, 86.3444 E - near Patkura (9.1 km): about 49 people (20% of 253) at 20.3116 N, 86.4309 E - near Patkura (10.8 km): about 26 people (11% of 247) at 20.3116 N, 86.3447 E Main roads under water: 4.7 km Source: Sentinel-1 flood atlas 2017-2026 + GloFAS discharge (IIT Bombay IDP prototype). Not an official warning.
info.instruction: Follow the district administration; keep off flooded roads.
